sharedPolicies: Coverage describes the exact selected publication, never all FEC history. Complete map means every applicable axis and unknown portion is represented; it does not assert complete source acquisition.

Keep source cycle, record/event dates, election year, report period, fiscal year, document publication and collection capture time separate. A capture in 2026 does not make all its records 2026 records.

Count each table row once per distinct bucket for list dimensions. Such rows may occupy multiple buckets; sum of bucket counts need not equal row count. Reconcile placed unique rows plus unplaced rows instead.

For reports, start and end are stated bounds. Mapping report periods to intervening months describes those reports stated periods, not monthly source completeness. Missing or reversed bounds remain explicit.
Use precision labels on legal dates. Day and month precision can place a month; year-only values can place a year but cannot place a month. Do not invent January dates from year precision.

Read publication member URLs for partitioned tables. Match key/hash/rows/bytes of carried tables at each generation; use the producing generation parents and readSnapshot. Never substitute the latest source pointer.

Collection IDs are scoped to the exact source generation. Evidence rows use their witness_generation_pin; target IDs are scoped by target table and target generation. Joining by collection_id or native matter/filing ID alone can give false matches.

Retained collection outcomes occur at collection grain, not table row grain. no-record-rejections establishes parsing of selected records, not source completeness. selection_context and inventory_only are metadata records, not successful requests.

The two qualified empty candidate collection observations establish no records only for their exact candidate filters and request. They do not mean there are no candidates for a whole cycle. The query outcomes table separately refuses unqualified empty-success claims.

Rows emitted by a table identify its used collections, but cannot identify selected attempts that emitted no rows. Family-level attempts may be shown separately; attributing them to a particular table requires that producer exact selection/read snapshot, not an arbitrary source-family join.

Current backend code has a newer receipt-only split than these public schemas. Recommendations bind the actual public older layout. Future published schemas need a fresh review, not silent adoption of today local source.
